about.title: About
about.privacy: Tapomo never stores what you type: it only counts keystrokes and timings.
about.privacy_passwords: Password fields are ignored entirely: not counted, not timed.
live.title: Right now
live.idle: Type and watch your pace live
live.calibrating: Calibrating… Keep typing so Tapomo learns your normal pace ({have}/{need} long bursts)
settings.show_pet.hint: A small floating Tapomo that reacts as you type. It never takes focus, clicks go through it except over Tapomo itself, and it hides during fullscreen apps. Drag it to move it.
settings.logs.hint: Log files with Tapomo's warnings and errors. They never contain what you type or which keys you press.
tip.avg: Words per minute (1 word = 5 characters), only while you type continuously: pauses longer than {pause} s don't count. "Net" also subtracts what you delete.
tip.peak: Your highest speed held for 10 seconds in a row.
tip.best: Characters in a row without pressing delete (your best no-backspace streak). It is kept even if you pause.
tip.current: Characters you have typed in a row right now without pressing delete. Back to zero when you delete.
tip.time: Real time spent typing: the sum of your bursts, without the pauses.
tip.chars: Number of characters typed in this period. They are only counted: which characters they are is never stored.
tip.heatmap: Each square is one hour of a weekday. The colour shows how fast you typed compared with your own usual pace; the stronger the colour, the more you typed in that hour.
tip.apps: Average speed and characters per program. You can give each one an alias by typing in its name.
tip.live: Compares your speed over the last 10 s with your usual good pace: 100% is the 90th percentile of your 10 s peaks over the last 30 days. You can go past it.
tip.burst: A burst is continuous typing. It ends when you stop for more than {pause} s, and bursts under 15 characters are discarded.
tip.longburst: Long burst: 10 seconds or more of typing without stopping. With {need} of them Tapomo knows your normal pace.
tip.pause: If you stop typing for longer than this, the burst ends and the pause is not counted in your speed.
tip.streak_today: Today your best streak is {n} characters without deleting!
tip.faster_than_usual: You're typing {p}% faster than usual today 🚀
tip.low_corrections: You only correct {p}% of what you type. Nicely done!
tip.near_record: Today's peak ({w} {u}) is just {d} {u} from your record
tip.record_today: You beat your speed record today: {w} {u}!
tip.best_hour: Your best hour is usually {h}:00. Make the most of it!
tip.volume_today: {n} characters so far today: about {pages} pages!
tip.calibrating: Keep typing: I'm learning your pace ({have}/{need})
tip.hello_empty: Hi! We haven't typed anything together yet today
tip.generic_1: Thinking pauses don't count: type at your own pace
tip.generic_2: If I get in the way, you can hide me from the tray
tip.generic_3: I never save what you type, I only count keys
gloss.title: Glossary
gloss.wpm.d: A "word" is 5 characters (spaces included), the international standard, so text with long words doesn't penalise you. It is the same speed as cpm, counted in words instead of characters.
gloss.cpm.d: Exactly the same as the keystrokes per minute (KPM) used by typing schools. Since a word is 5 characters, cpm = WPM × 5: 60 WPM is 300 cpm.
gloss.burst.d: Continuous typing without pauses longer than {pause} s. Bursts under 15 characters don't count.
gloss.peak.d: Your highest speed held for 10 seconds in a row.
gloss.streak.d: Characters in a row without pressing delete.
gloss.pace.d: Your usual good pace: the 90th percentile of your peaks over the last 30 days. You can beat it.
gloss.calibration.d: Tapomo needs {need} bursts of 10 s or more to learn your pace.
pet.hint: Click: say something · Double-click: open · Right-click: more
gloss.pet.d: Drag it to move it. Click: it tells you something. Double-click: opens this window. Right-click: menu (open, hide for an hour, hide, pause measuring).
pet.hide.fullscreen: I'm hiding while you watch something fullscreen

welcome.label: Welcome to Tapomo
welcome.1.title: Your privacy comes first
welcome.1.text: Tapomo only counts how many keys you press and when, never what you type. Password fields are ignored entirely and everything stays on your computer.
welcome.2.title: Getting to know your pace
welcome.2.text: The first 20 bursts help Tapomo learn your pace. From then on the bar is measured against yourself, not against anyone else.
welcome.3.title: Tapomo on your desktop
welcome.3.text: Tapomo keeps you company in a corner. Drag it wherever you like, click it to hear something nice, double-click to open this window and right-click for options. It hides by itself in fullscreen.
goal.title: Daily goal
goal.streak_start: Reach the goal today to start a streak
settings.goal.hint: Active minutes spent typing, pauses not counted. Reach it several days in a row and Tapomo celebrates with you.
settings.weekend_rest.hint: Saturday and Sunday aren't required: they never break the streak, and if you reach the goal they count anyway.
tip.goal: Active minutes are the real time spent typing (the sum of your bursts). One missed day a week doesn't break the streak: Tapomo uses a joker.
tip.goal_left_one: Only {n} min left to reach your goal
tip.goal_left: Only {n} min left to reach your goal
gloss.goal.d: The active minutes you want to type each day (10, 20 or 30). It counts the real time spent typing, the sum of your bursts, pauses excluded. It's a gentle target: everyone types at their own speed.
gloss.daystreak.d: Consecutive days reaching the goal. Every week (Monday to Sunday) you get one joker: a missed day doesn't break the streak and Tapomo spends it for you. With weekend rest on, Saturday and Sunday aren't required.
level.title: Level
level.aria: Level {lv}: {xp} of {next} XP to the next one
level.next_none: You have every reward! You can keep levelling up.
ch.title: Today's challenges
tip.challenges: Three challenges a day, tuned to your own average of the last two weeks. Each gives 15 XP, and all three together 15 more. Skipping them is fine: there are new ones tomorrow.
ch.long_bursts_one: Do one burst longer than 1 minute
ch.beat_avg: Beat your average pace ({wpm} wpm) in a burst of 20 s or more
ch.clean: Type {n} characters in a row without deleting
ch.full: Full house! All three: +15 bonus XP
wd.title: Tapomo's wardrobe
wd.hint: Every 3 levels you unlock a pack of two rewards. Tap one to put it on or take it off. If two things don't fit together, Tapomo takes off the one in the way.
wd.style.hint: Some rewards change with the style: subtle is more discreet.
lvup.title: Level {lv}!
lvup.retro.title: You start at level {lv}!
lvup.retro.text: Tapomo went through your history and turned it into XP.
gloss.xp.d: You earn XP by typing (up to 150 a day), meeting your goal, keeping your day streak, beating records and with today's challenges. XP is never lost. The first levels come fast and then space out: level 50 takes about a year of normal use.
gloss.challenges.d: Three new challenges every day, tuned to your average of the last two weeks. The ones you don't do simply disappear at midnight.
gloss.wardrobe.d: The rewards you unlock every 3 levels: skins, which change Tapomo's colour, and accessories and costumes it wears on top. You choose them in the wardrobe.
